g.text: Canonical axes · explicit RHS attributes · fixed proof budgets
Verified chain sizes: 3, 4, 5. Other markers show unsuccessful checks, not completed proofs.
Median of 5 runs; whiskers show min–max. Timing includes CLI report output. Default Bazel fastbuild.
Lower cost at larger sizes can reflect earlier budget exhaustion.
